objective: Perform the "REQUIREMENTS" role for work item "Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard".

input.workItemTitle: Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard
input.workItemDescription: Users on the analytics team need to export the current reporting dashboard view as a CSV file for offline analysis. No specific format or column list has been agreed yet.

discoveryReport.summary: The work item requests a feature allowing analytics team users to export the current reporting dashboard view to a CSV file for offline analysis.
findings: Target users are specifically identified as members of the analytics team.
The primary goal of the feature is enabling offline analysis.
The source data for the CSV export is the current view of the reporting dashboard.
Specific format requirements and column lists are currently missing from the request.

result.summary: This Product Requirements Document (PRD) defines the requirements for adding a CSV export capability to the reporting dashboard, enabling analytics team users to download the data from their current dashboard view for offline analysis.
requirements: The system shall provide a CSV export mechanism within the reporting dashboard.
The export functionality shall be accessible to members of the analytics team.
The CSV export shall contain the data corresponding to the user's current reporting dashboard view.
The exported file shall be generated in CSV format to support offline analysis.
